Basis: these totes shipped Charm CO -> Charm KS on Shipment #32/#33 (2 trucks, 34 QOWV totes, shipped 2025-10-21; BGN master tab "QOWV totes to KS Shipment #32&33"), were stored at Charm KS, then repositioned Charm KS -> Basco LA. They never rode a direct CO->LA truck, so they are excluded from table A and allocated their actual two-leg route here.

2. Precedent: INJ-05-2026-W1 "KS Rail" tab charges KS-routed material the actual via-KS path ("Rail via Maize" 3,380 mi vs 2,199 mi direct). Dropping the KS legs would understate transport. The via-KS truck route (1,221 mi) is 1.7% longer than direct (1,201 mi), so this is also the conservative treatment.
3. Leg 1 denominator: 34 totes across 2 trucks. The #32 vs #33 membership split is not recorded, but n/34 x 2 trucks = n/17 x 1 truck, so the split does not change the allocated miles.

4. Leg 2 denominator: 6 totes = the Kansas totes recreated at LA per the QOWV_32_33 tracker (118811, 118837, 118872, 118886, 118846, 120584). Tag 197262 was removed from scope 2026-08-25; had it ridden this truck the denominator would be 7, which allocates fewer miles - 6 is the conservative choice.

5. Distance sources: filed route maps linked at B21:C22 - "Charm CO to Charm KS.png" (537 mi, I-70 E) and "Charm KS to Charm LA.png" (684 mi, I-49 S). Attach both to the Certify transport-distance datapoints for these removals.
